---
name: Nominate a Maintainer
about: For Maintainers nominating someone for the Maintainer role. See COMMUNITY_ROLES.md.
title: "Nominate @<handle> as a Maintainer"
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

_Nominee_: @<handle>

_Company_:

> Their current employer, or Independent.

_Areas_:

> The areas of the project they would maintain.

_Why_:

> Their record as a Reviewer, design work such as proposals they wrote or shepherded, and how
> they have helped the project and community.

_Pull requests authored_:

> Links to substantial merged pull requests.

_Pull requests reviewed_:

> Links, or a search such as `is:pr reviewed-by:<handle> -author:<handle>`.

---

Checklist (see COMMUNITY_ROLES.md for the full process):

- [ ] The nominee has commented to accept.
- [ ] The TSC has approved by majority vote, as the Technical Charter requires. For a vote held
      in this issue, that is a majority of all TSC voting members.
- [ ] Pull request moving the nominee to `maintainers` in `OWNERS` and updating `MAINTAINERS.md` is merged.
- [ ] An organization admin has updated the nominee's GitHub access.
